 Wife of former pro-democracy lawmaker calls sentence a 'political judgement'
 Veteran pro-democracy former lawmaker Au Kam San poses for a photo in Macao in October 2024.  © AP
 KENJI KAWASE November 6, 2026 17:50 JST Updated on November 6, 2026 18:32 JST TOKYO -- Au Kam-san, a former Macao lawmaker and veteran pro-democracy activist, was sentenced Friday to 12 and a half years in prison in the former Portuguese colony's first national security prosecution.
